Annual Report
On the following pages Psi Upsilon is pleased to recognize
donors who made unrestricted contributions to the 2005
Annual Fund . Donors contributing $ 250 or more are recog-
nized as memers of the Founders' Society . Those giv ing
V one dollar for each year since the founding of Psi
Upsilon ( $172 ) are recognized as members of the
Anniversary Club . Years of consecutive giving are
shown in parentheses after the name and class year of
each donor. Donors who increased the amount of their gift
in 2005 have the A symbol with their name. These contribu -
tions were made to the Psi Upsilon Foundation or Psi Upsilon
Fraternity between January 1 and December 31, 2005.

Psi Upsilon Values
Lifelong friendship - Psi Upsilon unites its members in a
diverse brotherhood of firm and enduring friendship that will last
a lifetime.

Intellectual engagement - Psi Upsilon fosters individual and
chapter support for the academic mission of the University and
creates opportunities for co-curricular learning and personal
development.

Ethical leadership - Psi l psiIon 's system of self-governance
nurtures development of mature decision-making, individual
responsibility and ethical leadership.

Responsible social conduct - Psi Upsilon is dedicated to
providing a safe and healthful living-learning environment for its
members who are guided by principles of responsibility, civility
and courtesy.

Service - Psi Upsilon encourages service to university, com -
munity, country and fraternity.
